about.title: About Me
about.p1: I merge analytical thinking with technical execution. My philosophy is rooted in understanding the core business processes before writing a single line of code. This dual approach as a System Analyst and Front-End Developer allows me to build solutions that are not just visually stunning, but functionally robust.
about.p2: Whether it's streamlining supply chains with UML or crafting zero-latency interfaces with Next.js, I strive for excellence in every layer of the stack.
